headline: Sales grow and net turns positive but operations still lose
summary_short: SK bioscience reported Q3 revenue of ₩182.4B, up 21.0% y/y, with an operating loss of ₩11.2B versus ₩19.4B a year ago.
summary_long: Net income was ₩12.0B and EPS was ₩135, up from a loss of ₩229 last quarter but down from ₩313 a year ago. Nine-month revenue was ₩506.8B, up 8.5%, with a cumulative operating loss of ₩71.5B.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue, operating loss and net income come from a third-party filing summary of preliminary results; EPS comparisons are from the shard. The prior-year operating loss of ₩19.4B is from press coverage of Q3 2025.
